meta.title: SŌN — Beyond the Frame.
meta.description: SŌN is a fusuma art brand from Japan. Works built the way a fusuma is built — wooden lattice, layered paper, a wooden edge — and finished with sumi ink.

common.illustration: Illustration — photographs of the works will replace these drawings.

hero.lead: Fusuma, reimagined as contemporary art. Each work is built the way a Japanese sliding door is built — so the frame is part of the work.
hero.visualAlt: Illustration of a SŌN work: a single sumi brushstroke low on an ivory paper panel with a dark wooden edge.

statement.label: Mission
statement.text: To carry the Japanese fusuma forward — from a sliding door in a Japanese home to contemporary art recognised around the world.

collection.label: First collection
collection.title: Three series, in development
collection.lead: The first works are being designed and prototyped now. Sizes are planned sizes.

structure.label: Built like a fusuma
structure.title: The frame is not around the work. It is the work.
structure.lead: A framed calligraphy is paper behind glass. A SŌN work is made with the structure of a fusuma, layer by layer.

layers.name: Hikite
layers.body: The recessed pull. In SŌN works, a point of punctuation — or a signature.

layers.name: Edge
layers.body: A wooden edge chosen for each work. It frames the panel and belongs to it.

layers.name: Face paper
layers.body: The final washi surface that receives the ink.

layers.name: Underlayers
layers.body: Layers of paper pasted one over another, giving the surface its tension and depth.

layers.name: Lattice core
layers.body: A light wooden lattice at the centre of the panel.

structure.note: Layer names and methods will be confirmed with the artisans we work with.

name.label: The name
name.title: SŌN
name.note: SPIRIT, ORIGIN and NEW are a concept we created for the brand. They are not the etymology of the name.

letters.body: The tradition of Japan, the care of the artisans, and the soul in every work.
A culture born in Japan, and the origin of fusuma art.
Not only preserving tradition, but carrying it forward as a new art.

story.title: Story
story.lead: SŌN begins with the Japanese fusuma — and asks what it can become beyond the home it was made for.

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: To carry the Japanese fusuma forward as contemporary art recognised around the world.

concept.label: Concept
concept.text: Japanese tradition is our origin. We carry the spirit held in it to the world as a new art.

beyond.label: Beyond the Frame.
beyond.title: Three frames we want to move beyond

points.title: The picture frame
points.body: Instead of putting calligraphy in a frame, we build the work with the fusuma's own structure. Its wooden edge is part of the piece.

points.title: The door
points.body: A fusuma is usually something you slide open and closed. We treat it as art that can live on a wall — and one day, again as a door.

points.title: The border
points.body: From Japanese homes to galleries, homes and hotels around the world.

process.label: Process
process.title: How a work is made
process.lead: Our planned process. It will be refined with the artisans as the first works are made.

steps.title: Lattice
steps.body: A light wooden lattice is prepared as the core.

steps.title: Underlayers
steps.body: Paper is pasted in layers to give the surface tension and depth.

steps.title: Brush
steps.body: The character or stroke is written in sumi ink — once.

steps.title: Seal and edge
steps.body: The work is sealed, and the wooden edge is fitted.

steps.title: Record
steps.body: Each finished work receives a work number and a certificate of authenticity.

people.label: People
people.text: SŌN is a project by kerokero, founded by a student in Japan and made together with fusuma artisans. Names and stories will be shared here with each person's permission.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.lead: Fusuma art doors — real sliding doors carrying calligraphy and contemporary art — for hotels, restaurants, private homes and galleries.
commissions.status: A future product. We are starting conversations with architects and interior designers now; we are not taking orders yet.

points.title: Made to the opening
points.body: Each door would be designed for the dimensions, sliding method and conditions of the site.

points.title: Art you can use
points.body: A door that opens and closes, with a surface made as a work of art.

points.title: Built to be cared for
points.body: Fusuma are traditionally repaired and re-papered. We plan for maintenance from the start.

shipping.title: Shipping & Care
shipping.draft: Draft — these terms will be confirmed before the first works are offered.

sections.title: Shipping
sections.body: Works ship from Japan, insured and packed for the journey. Shipping costs depend on the destination and are quoted before purchase.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Payment details are shared after we confirm your inquiry.

sections.title: Duties and taxes
sections.body: Import duties and taxes depend on your country. Who pays them will be stated in each quote.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Each work is unique or made in a small edition, so returns are generally not accepted. If a work arrives damaged or differs from its description, we will make it right.

sections.title: If a work arrives damaged
sections.body: Contact us within the period stated in your quote, with photographs of the work and the packaging. We will arrange a repair or a refund.

sections.title: Care
sections.body: Keep the work away from direct sunlight, heaters and humid places. Do not touch the paper surface; dust gently with a soft, dry brush. For repairs, contact SŌN.
